name: worldly
description: A geography study app — an interactive, pannable/zoomable world map for learning every country, not just the big ones. Two untimed quiz modes (find it on the map / type its name), region filtering, per-country miss-tracking that weights future quizzes toward what you get wrong, a mastery heat-map, and session stats.

scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && npm run dev -w packages/client
scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build -w packages/client
